gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Storybook curves with open jaws lead in Mystery Quest, while Noto Sans Oriya brings generous curve gaps. Body text can go a size up, since its small letters run tall.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Open-jawed curves give Mystery Quest its bookish, nostalgic lean up front. Noto Sans Palmyrene does the opposite job, staying clean and modern with curves that stop short while the heading handles the storytelling.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-phoenicia: Noto Sans Phoenician brings modern openness and generous lowercase height. Mystery Quest brings bookish nostalgia, and that gap in temperament, display charm against contemporary ease, is what makes this pairing work.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-psalter-p: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi keeps its capitals barely rising, with gaping e mouths. Mystery Quest wears its bookish nostalgia openly, while the body text beside it stays approachable and businesslike.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang is a contemporary sans whose lowercase counters look like wide glass portholes under Mystery Quest headings. Body text at a modest size will let those openings show.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic reads modern and unfussy, with a big x-height that gives Mystery Quest a steady partner. Page after page would go down smoothly, never tiring the eye.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan brings a hefty lowercase and plenty of daylight. Mystery Quest does best at mood, with bookish, nostalgic jaws, while the body font does best at approachable, professional clarity.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-syloti-na: Nostalgic Mystery Quest leads, with open jaws on every curve. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri takes over, clean and tall in the x-height, so extended text would move along smoothly without tiring.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-syriac-we: Bookish open jaws up top, Mystery Quest dressed in pure nostalgia. Noto Sans Syriac Western reads modern and clean across a stretch, its terminals held far from the stroke.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-warang-ci: Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic open jaws to every curve, a display voice with some character. But Noto Sans Warang Citi makes words read as solid blocks, so extended text feels clean and settled.
